title: Site in Texas that teaches blindfolded sensing

tellings.quote: there's I think a site in Texas that teaches people to kind of develop these senses

plain: There is said to be a place in Texas that teaches people to develop senses beyond the usual ones, such as sensing things while blindfolded. Michels mentions this himself, unsure of the details ("I think a site in Texas"), in an episode with the biologist Rupert Sheldrake. He brings it up as a sign that such abilities might be trained.
